task_description: The agents need to collaboratively develop a feature for a software application. This involves writing code according to specified requirements, reviewing the code for quality and adherence to standards, testing the code for functionality, and finally integrating the code into the main codebase.
expected_outcome: If all steps are executed correctly, the new feature should be successfully implemented, reviewed, tested, and integrated without any issues, resulting in a working addition to the software application.

agents.description: This agent gathers and documents the requirements for the new feature.
This agent writes code based on the requirements provided.
This agent reviews the code for quality and adherence to standards.
This agent tests the code for functionality and reports any bugs found.
This agent is responsible for integrating the code into the main codebase and resolving any conflicts that arise.
